text:
Didn't they?
Someone used to
say that, didn't they?
Who knows...
All troops, resume the march!
Understood!
Are you sure?
Are you sure?
Are you sure?
Are you sure?
I don't know.
But...
I'm certain
she and her troops
didn't set those fires...
I don't know.
But...
I have a feeling
she and her troops
didn't set those fires...
Seems that way.
With that many soldiers,
there's no way they could
sneak around setting fires.
Oh...
If so, then who
could have started them...?
But in that case,
who has been going around
setting fires?
Under the circumstances...
It was natural
for us to suspect
the Imperial Army, wasn't it?
Well, who else
could we have suspected?
But what if
that very assumption
was the trap...?
Huh?
Huh?
Huh?
Huh?
There was something unnatural...
Something
that troubled me.
What if this situation,
with us and the Imperial Army
at one another's throats...
was exactly what
the arsonist wanted!?
I told you, didn't I?
Until I get an answer,
I absolutely won't
let you through...
I told you, didn't I?
Until I get an answer,
I absolutely won't
let you through.
Ghh...
If you still won't answer,
I have other ways of making you.
Do you intend
to remain silent
until you die?
Stoooop!!
Galeor...
The one who set the fires...
was Vijue...
!?
!?
!?
!?
He took some soldiers
without permission...
and did it himself...!
Ghh...
Then...
You mean there's
a split in your ranks...
